edits.old: Then the rate is a read of these entries and neither the measure definition nor its threshold is written in this service
edits.new:
Then the rate is a read of these entries and neither the measure definition nor its threshold is written in this service

  Scenario: AC9 The ledger keeps one entry per agent step, stays append only and chained, and holds no personal data (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the record of the step on case "RW-2026-000201" was written with the rule result applied and fallback false
    When rwb-decision consumes the DecisionRecorded event of that step
    Then the case holds one agent step record and one entry, and the entry holds the agent version and the fallback fact on the same row
    Then this service makes no update and no delete of any decision_log_entry row, and the nightly JOB-14 chain check covers the entry
    Then the event, the trail and the logs carry case and run identifiers, a decision code, version labels, a final call, statuses, reasons and dates only, and the inputs reference points at a masked snapshot
    Then the decision code, the fallback reasons, the agent version form and the message texts are read from their list, contract and message rows and are not constants of this service
    Given a record that fails the ledger schema is delivered for case "RW-2026-000202"
    When rwb-decision consumes that record
    Then it is refused with MSG-P7-009 naming the field, nothing is chained, the chain stays continuous and the record is held on the retry and dead-letter path with an alert

  Scenario: AC10 A read without a credential is answered 401 on both reads (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the entry of the step on case "RW-2026-000201" is on the ledger at chain_seq 231
    When a caller sends GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log?caseId=RW-2026-000201 without a credential
    Then the answer is 401 and no entry is returned
    When a caller sends GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} without a credential
    Then the answer is 401 and no entry is returned
